title: Mike Macdonald on Rashid Shaheed's limited production: "The ball will find him"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald on Rashid Shaheed's limited production: "The ball will find him"
sources.description: In June, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said he was "excited to see" what receiver Rashid Shaheed would do in the offense, given the benefit of having the full offseason and training camp to prepare for his first full year with the team.
